In the mid-90s, an Italian development team known as "Graffiti" created Screamer - an excellent arcade racing game for PC, clearly inspired by Ridge Racer and Daytona USA. Sequels followed. Graffiti became Milestone. But the arcade racing games kept coming and recently, powered by an adept use of Unreal Engine 5, Screamer has returned. John Linneman as the full story.
